name: Bricks
overview: The Bible references bricks as fundamental building materials, highlighting human effort and provision in construction, as seen when people made bricks and used slime for mortar (Genesis 11:3). The account in Exodus 5:7 shows the burden placed on the Israelites to gather straw for brick-making, emphasizing the labor involved in their oppression. Hebrews 3:4 reminds believers that while humans build houses and structures, God is the ultimate Creator of all things, pointing to His sovereignty over human endeavors and creation.
